name: BasicMOSFETModels
_comment_tr: MOSFET kucuk-sinyal sablonu - Basic seviye (Analog Insydes BasicMOSFETSmallSignal, simp==2). Topoloji: g_ds, C_gs, C_gd, C_bd, C_bs, gm. Sembol degerleri (cgd=CGD+CGDOV toplami, rds=1/GDS, ...) netlist/Model.py._mosfet_ac_param_values icinde AI'nin DoMOSFETSmallSignal formulleriyle cozulur.
_comment_en: MOSFET small-signal template - Basic level (Analog Insydes BasicMOSFETSmallSignal, simp==2). Topology: g_ds, C_gs, C_gd, C_bd, C_bs, gm. Symbol values (cgd = CGD+CGDOV sum, rds = 1/GDS, ...) are resolved in netlist/Model.py._mosfet_ac_param_values using AI's DoMOSFETSmallSignal formulas.
